description: A Java class implementing a FreeMarker TemplateTransformModel for rendering editable sub-content within OFBiz. It handles sub-content data retrieval, wrapping content in templates, and integrating with OFBiz content and entity services.

classes.name: EditRenderSubContentTransform
classes.description: Implements FreeMarker's TemplateTransformModel to allow dynamic editing and rendering of sub-content within OFBiz templates.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Creates a writer that processes the embedded FTL content, wraps it for editing if 'editTemplate' is true, and manages content rendering and sub-content data fetching.

methods.name: getWrappedObject
methods.description: Deprecated method to get wrapped objects from the environment; recommends using FreeMarkerWorker.getWrappedObject.

methods.name: getArg
methods.description: Deprecated method to extract arguments; recommends using FreeMarkerWorker.getArg.
